verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an email service, but the evidence pack never documents them: there are no auto-delete or retention-period settings, no purge policies and no account or data deletion features. The pack contains only feature titles (Filters & Rules, Snooze, Masked Email), JMAP protocol material, and a vague community remark that Fastmail is up front about data handling, none of which shows user-controlled retention or deletion.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
